title: tox installs no package
description: tox.ini declares a `skip_install` switch that tests something other than the built artifact. A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a `skip_install` switch that tests something other than the built artifact.
remediation: Turn the control back on and fix what it reported instead of disabling the check. Specifically: fix a `skip_install` switch that tests something other than the built artifact.
limitation: It matches a `skip_install` switch that tests something other than the built artifact in the parsed tox.ini; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
